project.name: bolkese
project.description: Turkish gold, FX, and cash portfolio tracker with a React/Vite UI, Express/SQLite API, and live altinapi prices.

nodes.name: altinProxy.js
nodes.summary: Express handler that proxies GET /api/altin to altinapi, attaching the server-side API key and forwarding the upstream body.

nodes.name: altinProxy
nodes.summary: Forwards allowed GET requests to altinapi with X-API-Key, then relays status, content type, and body or returns Turkish error JSON.

nodes.name: auth.js
nodes.summary: JWT helpers that sign and verify session tokens and set or clear the HttpOnly bolkese_token cookie.

nodes.name: signToken
nodes.summary: Signs a seven-day JWT whose subject is the user id.

nodes.name: readToken
nodes.summary: Verifies a JWT and returns its payload using the server JWT secret.

nodes.name: setAuthCookie
nodes.summary: Writes the HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie with a seven-day max age.

nodes.name: clearAuthCookie
nodes.summary: Clears the session cookie on logout.

nodes.name: db.js
nodes.summary: Opens the SQLite database under backend/data, enables WAL and foreign keys, applies schema.sql, then seeds lookup rows.

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Express entry point that enables JSON and cookies, mounts health, altin proxy, and auth/asset/lookup/movement routers, then starts the server.

nodes.name: logMovement.js
nodes.summary: Inserts a movement row when an asset amount changes so buy and sell history can be listed later.

nodes.name: logAmountChange
nodes.summary: Writes a movement with direction, quantity, and unit value when the new amount differs from the previous amount.

nodes.name: requireAuth.js
nodes.summary: Auth middleware that reads the session cookie, verifies the JWT, loads the user from SQLite, and attaches req.user.

nodes.name: requireAuth
nodes.summary: Rejects missing or invalid tokens with 401, otherwise loads the user row and continues the request.

nodes.name: assets.js
nodes.summary: Authenticated CRUD for the current user's assets, including symbol/unit checks, TRY price locking, and movement logging on amount changes.

nodes.name: toAsset
nodes.summary: Maps a database asset row to the public API shape, renaming preset_key to key and forcing change to 0.

nodes.name: GET /api/assets
nodes.summary: Lists the authenticated user's assets in creation order.

nodes.name: POST /api/assets
nodes.summary: Creates an asset owned by the current user after validating name, code, and unit against lookup tables.

nodes.name: PATCH /api/assets/:id
nodes.summary: Updates amount, bid, and ask for an owned asset and logs a movement when quantity changes.

nodes.name: DELETE /api/assets/:id
nodes.summary: Deletes an owned asset or returns 404/403 when the row is missing or belongs to another user.

nodes.name: auth.js
nodes.summary: Register, login, logout, and current-user routes that hash passwords, issue cookies, and return public user objects.

nodes.name: POST /api/auth/register
nodes.summary: Creates a user after email, name, and password checks, then sets the session cookie.

nodes.name: POST /api/auth/login
nodes.summary: Authenticates email and password with bcrypt and sets the session cookie.

nodes.name: POST /api/auth/logout
nodes.summary: Clears the session cookie and returns a success payload.

nodes.name: GET /api/auth/me
nodes.summary: Returns the public user object for the authenticated session.

nodes.name: lookups.js
nodes.summary: Authenticated lookup route that returns unit and symbol catalogs used when creating assets.

nodes.name: GET /api/lookups
nodes.summary: Returns units and symbols from the seeded lookup tables.

nodes.name: movements.js
nodes.summary: Authenticated listing of the current user's asset movements with optional date, asset, and direction filters.

nodes.name: toMovement
nodes.summary: Maps a joined movement row to the public movement payload used by reports.

nodes.name: GET /api/movements
nodes.summary: Lists owned movements newest first, filtered by optional from, to, assetId, and direction query params.

nodes.name: seedLookups.js
nodes.summary: Startup seeder that INSERT OR REPLACE units, sixty-six altinapi symbols, and TRY into lookup tables.

nodes.name: seedLookups
nodes.summary: Runs a transaction that upserts the static unit and symbol catalogs into SQLite.

nodes.name: App.jsx
nodes.summary: Main React shell: session bootstrap, portfolio layout, asset/market/report views, and add/update modals with live prices.

nodes.name: migrateAssets
nodes.summary: Normalizes stored asset codes (XAU/GA, USD, EUR) and numeric amount/price/ask fields.

nodes.name: migrateLocalAssets
nodes.summary: Uploads leftover localStorage assets to the API when the server list is empty, then clears the local key.

nodes.name: groupSymbols
nodes.summary: Groups lookup symbols by category for the add-asset picker.

nodes.name: assetDraftFromQuote
nodes.summary: Builds an add-asset draft from a market quote using preset icon/color when available.

nodes.name: IconBadge
nodes.summary: Renders a colored Lucide icon badge used on asset cards and pickers.

nodes.name: Modal
nodes.summary: Accessible dialog shell with overlay click and Escape to close, locking body scroll while open.

nodes.name: PricePair
nodes.summary: Shows bid and ask as alış/satış with optional live-lock styling.

nodes.name: AddAssetModal
nodes.summary: Modal to create an asset from presets or lookup code/unit selects, submitting amount and prices.

nodes.name: UpdateAssetModal
nodes.summary: Modal to change amount and, when live quotes are missing, manual bid/ask for an existing asset.

nodes.name: EmptyState
nodes.summary: Empty portfolio prompt that offers adding the first asset.

nodes.name: AssetCard
nodes.summary: Compact asset row showing amount, value, and change with update/delete actions.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root component that restores the session via GET /api/auth/me then shows AuthScreen or Portfolio.

nodes.name: Portfolio
nodes.summary: Authenticated workspace: loads assets and lookups, refreshes live prices, and switches Varlıklarım/Piyasalar/Raporlar views.

nodes.name: AssetsPage.jsx
nodes.summary: Owned-assets list with search, totals, and per-row amount update or delete.

nodes.name: AssetsPage
nodes.summary: Filters holdings by name/code and renders cards with formatted TRY values.

nodes.name: AuthScreen.jsx
nodes.summary: Login and register form with remember-me and password visibility toggle.

nodes.name: AuthScreen
nodes.summary: Submits register or login and reports API errors in Turkish.

nodes.name: MarketsPage.jsx
nodes.summary: Grouped live quotes with search and add-from-row into the portfolio.

nodes.name: MarketsPage
nodes.summary: Groups quotes by category and lets the user add a watched symbol as an asset.

nodes.name: auth.js
nodes.summary: Cookie-authenticated register, login, logout, and session restore helpers.

nodes.name: registerAccount
nodes.summary: POSTs name, email, and password to create an account and session cookie.

nodes.name: loginAccount
nodes.summary: POSTs credentials and remember flag to start a session.

nodes.name: logoutAccount
nodes.summary: POSTs logout so the server clears the session cookie.

nodes.name: fetchMe
nodes.summary: GETs the current user from the session cookie.

nodes.name: prices.js
nodes.summary: Fetches bulk and single altinapi quotes through /api/altin and maps bid/ask payloads.

nodes.name: PriceRequestError
nodes.summary: Error type carrying HTTP status for price request failures.

nodes.name: messageForStatus
nodes.summary: Maps 401/403/429/503 to Turkish user-facing price error messages.

nodes.name: parseError
nodes.summary: Turns a failed price response into a PriceRequestError.

nodes.name: toQuote
nodes.summary: Normalizes an API row into symbol, bid, ask, timestamp, and stale flags.

nodes.name: fetchPrices
nodes.summary: Loads a batch of quotes from /api/altin/prices.

nodes.name: fetchPrice
nodes.summary: Loads one symbol quote or returns null on 404.

nodes.name: symbolLabels.js
nodes.summary: Category order, titles, and helpers that label and group market quotes for the Piyasalar view.

nodes.name: labelFor
nodes.summary: Returns the display label for a market symbol code.

nodes.name: categoryTitle
nodes.summary: Returns the Turkish title for a quote category key.

nodes.name: groupQuotes
nodes.summary: Buckets quotes into the canonical category order for the markets list.

nodes.name: useMarketPrices.js
nodes.summary: Hook that refreshes quotes on an interval, tracks visibility, and computes percent change vs a local snapshot.

nodes.name: useMarketPrices
nodes.summary: Fetches prices every 45s while visible and stores a bid snapshot for change percentages.

nodes.name: main.jsx
nodes.summary: Vite/React bootstrap that mounts App in StrictMode and loads global CSS.

nodes.name: ReportsPage.jsx
nodes.summary: Reports view that lists quantity movements with date, category, and direction filters, including CSV export and orphaned-asset rows.

nodes.name: exportMovements
nodes.summary: Builds a Turkish-header CSV of movement rows and triggers a dated file download.

nodes.name: ReportsPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported React page that fetches movements, applies filters, and renders a filterable movement table with export.

nodes.name: assets.js
nodes.summary: Thin API wrappers for listing, creating, updating, and deleting the signed-in user's asset records.

nodes.name: fetchAssets
nodes.summary: GET /api/assets and returns the authenticated user's asset list.

nodes.name: createAssetRecord
nodes.summary: POST /api/assets with a JSON payload to create a new asset record.

nodes.name: updateAssetRecord
nodes.summary: PATCH /api/assets/:id with a JSON payload to update amount or prices.

nodes.name: deleteAssetRecord
nodes.summary: DELETE /api/assets/:id to remove an owned asset record.

nodes.name: client.js
nodes.summary: Shared JSON fetch helper that sends cookies, parses error bodies, and throws ApiError on non-OK responses.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Error subclass that carries the HTTP status and a Turkish or server-provided message.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Performs a credentials-included JSON request and returns the parsed body or throws ApiError.

nodes.name: lookups.js
nodes.summary: Fetches authenticated unit and symbol lookup lists from GET /api/lookups.

nodes.name: fetchLookups
nodes.summary: GET /api/lookups via the shared request helper.

nodes.name: movements.js
nodes.summary: Builds optional query params and fetches quantity movement history from GET /api/movements.

nodes.name: fetchMovements
nodes.summary: GET /api/movements with optional from, to, assetId, and direction query filters.

nodes.name: exportCsv.js
nodes.summary: Semicolon-delimited CSV helpers that escape fields and download a UTF-8 BOM file in the browser.

nodes.name: toCsv
nodes.summary: Joins headers and records into a semicolon-delimited CSV string with escaped fields.

nodes.name: downloadCsv
nodes.summary: Creates a Blob URL and clicks a temporary anchor to download a UTF-8 BOM CSV file.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes node_modules, SQLite data, and env files from the backend image context while keeping .env.example.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Production Node 22 image that installs native build tools for npm ci, copies backend/src, and runs src/index.js on port 4000.
nodes.languageNotes: Installs python3/make/g++ only for better-sqlite3 compile, then purges them before the runtime user switch.

nodes.name: node
nodes.summary: Single-stage node:22-bookworm-slim service exposing port 4000 as the Express backend container.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes node_modules, dist, and environment files from the frontend Docker build context while keeping .env.example.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage frontend image that builds the Vite React app with Node 22 and serves the static dist plus nginx.conf on port 80.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-stage Dockerfile: Node bookworm-slim compiles assets, then nginx:1.27-alpine serves them.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Build stage that installs npm dependencies and runs npm run build to produce the frontend dist output.

nodes.name: nginx
nodes.summary: Runtime stage that copies nginx routing config and static dist files, then exposes HTTP port 80.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Root example environment file listing JWT_SECRET and ALTINAPI_KEY for Docker Compose and backend runtime secrets.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent working guide covering BolKese architecture, entities, API contracts, market integration, UI rules, and how to run and verify changes.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project getting-started guide for Docker Compose and local Vite/Express development, including ports and environment variable setup.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the backend Express image and frontend nginx image, injecting secrets, persisting SQLite on a named volume, and publishing the UI on port 8080.

nodes.name: skills.md
nodes.summary: Outdated frontend design notes on components, CSS tokens, layout, and accessibility; several claims (no backend, random prices, localStorage-only assets) no longer match the codebase.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Documents the frontend ALTINAPI_KEY placeholder used by the Vite gold-price proxy so the API key stays on the server, not in the browser bundle.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Turkish HTML shell for BolKese that sets viewport, theme color, and favicon, then mounts the React app from main.jsx into #root.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Frontend npm package that declares ESM, Vite/React scripts, and UI dependencies for the BolKese client.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Documents backend PORT (default 4000) and required JWT_SECRET so local Express can bind and sign session cookies without committing secrets.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Backend npm package that starts Express via src/index.js and lists SQLite, auth, and cookie dependencies.

nodes.name: schema.sql
nodes.summary: SQLite bootstrap schema for users, portfolio assets, quantity movements, and lookup units/symbols, applied when the database opens.
nodes.languageNotes: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with foreign keys; CASCADE on user delete and SET NULL on movement asset delete. Does not migrate existing tables.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Account table storing UUID id, unique email, bcrypt password hash, display name, and created_at.

nodes.name: assets
nodes.summary: Per-user portfolio holdings with code, unit, amount, bid/ask prices, icon/color, and optional preset_key.

nodes.name: movements
nodes.summary: Quantity movement log per user with direction, quantity, running balance, and optional asset_id.

nodes.name: units
nodes.summary: Lookup of allowed amount units (value primary key and Turkish label).

nodes.name: symbols
nodes.summary: Lookup of market symbol codes with description and category, including altinapi symbols and TRY.

nodes.name: hosting.json
nodes.summary: OpenAI Apps hosting metadata that publishes the frontend static build from the Vite dist directory.

nodes.name: nginx.conf
nodes.summary: nginx server that serves the built SPA from /usr/share/nginx/html and reverse-proxies /api/ to the Express backend, forwarding cookies.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Global BolKese stylesheet with design tokens, auth and portfolio components, focus styles, reduced-motion rules, and responsive breakpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS custom properties on :root plus media queries at 1060, 820, and 640 px.

nodes.name: vite.config.js
nodes.summary: Vite React config that proxies /api/altin to altinapi with X-API-Key and other /api traffic to local Express on port 4000 for both dev and preview.
nodes.languageNotes: loadEnv reads ALTINAPI_KEY without a VITE_ prefix so the key is not exposed to the client bundle.

nodes.name: altinProxy
nodes.summary: Builds the Vite proxy map that rewrites /api/altin to altinapi /api/v1 and injects the X-API-Key header.

tour.title: Project overview
tour.description: Start with the README to see how BolKese tracks gold, FX, and cash, and how Docker versus local Vite/Express development works.

tour.title: Frontend boot
tour.description: main.jsx mounts App under StrictMode. App restores the session cookie then shows AuthScreen or the Portfolio workspace.

tour.title: Session and API client
tour.description: The shared request helper sends credentials: include. Auth helpers login and restore the user; requireAuth on the server verifies the HttpOnly JWT cookie.

tour.title: Express entry and routes
tour.description: backend/src/index.js mounts health, the altinapi proxy, and authenticated asset, lookup, and movement routers.

tour.title: SQLite schema and seeds
tour.description: schema.sql defines users, assets, movements, units, and symbols. db.js applies it and seedLookups fills units plus 66 altinapi symbols and TRY.

tour.title: Holdings UI
tour.description: AssetsPage lists the current user's holdings. Amount changes go through PATCH /api/assets/:id and logMovement writes a movement row.

tour.title: Live prices
tour.description: useMarketPrices polls /api/altin/prices every 45 seconds. MarketsPage groups quotes; bid is alış and ask is satış. TRY stays locked at 1.

tour.title: Reports and movements
tour.description: ReportsPage loads movement history and can export CSV. The backend lists owned movements with optional filters.

tour.title: Packaging
tour.description: docker-compose runs nginx on 8080 and Express. nginx routes /api/ to the backend; local Vite still proxies /api/altin first.
